Method of Attack: Social engineering attack that scrambles text on compromised websites to simulate missing Roboto Condensed font, prompting users to download a fake font pack executable. Once executed, installs malware payloads including Monero miners, Trojan.Downloaders, and Ursnif keylogger.
Attack Vector: Compromised legitimate websites with injected JavaScript that scrambles text and displays fake font missing alerts. User interaction to manually download and execute the fake font pack executable.
Indicators of Compromise: Downloaded files named chromefp60.exe (for Chrome users) and mozillafp60.exe (for Firefox users). Fake alerts claiming missing 'Roboto Condensed' font and prompting font pack update.
